interface.longDescription: Sacred Oracle is a heart-centered business planning coach for spiritual entrepreneurs. It guides you, one question at a time, through the six sections of the Sacred Six Framework by Vanessa Lambert of The Starseed Collective, starting with Sacred Structure. Each section covers foundation, strategy, implementation, and integration, and ends with a clean, copy-ready summary you can paste straight into your business plan. Returning users can upload their plan and pick up right where they left off. Sacred Oracle offers business strategy guidance, not financial, legal, or medical advice.

name: sacred-oracle-sacred-six
